comparison.objective: Open a spring-loaded flange gap and insert a blind plate, not configure a gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a resisting flange while feeding and centering a plate.
comparison.success_condition: Plate is centered and captured when the flange is eased back.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual force coordination is generic; the task tests held-open insertion rather than threaded setting and locking.
